result.notes:
State checked: working tree at commit 35d5bfb. issues.md was being edited by the main session during this check (third pass, I-46 and I-47, citations of new diagnostics). The I-39 section is identical to commit 61841be, every quote above was confirmed present at 35d5bfb, and line numbers are those of 35d5bfb.

Result: no high-severity problem. The conclusion of I-39 is carried faithfully, and each of the five in-place corrections of I-39 has an accurate row in the corrections table (one row's reason is too broad, listed above). Of the 14 report items (6 errors, 8 caveats), 9 are carried correctly: errors 1, 2, 3 and caveats 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8. Error 4 is corrected in I-39 but survives in I-28, in I-03 without a superseding note, and in the manuscript values map. Caveat 5 lost its limit. Error 5 and caveat 4 are not carried. Error 6 was applied to issues.md only, not to the two files the report names. Nothing was flagged as deferred for this report, so not_yet_due is empty; if errors 5 and 6 are meant for the code pass, they need a recorded loose end.

Recomputed here and in agreement with issues.md (scripts recompute1.py to recompute7.py in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-WGBS-gigas-ploidy-desiccation/ed665b6a-3457-5aca-a521-7838dbc31cfa/scratchpad/wf/check-C1-universe/): universe 48,263 lines and 27,469 names; 43,184 annotated mRNAs; 15,715 missing (36.39%); run of 15,666 from XM_011455141.3 to XM_034461018.1 bounded by XM_011455140.3 and XM_034461020.1; 49 others in 24 runs; all 11 per-sequence shares (35.26% on NC_047565.1, 35.75% on NC_047568.1); 9,761 mRNAs of the XM_034 series on NC_047565.1 to NC_047568.1 with none in the universe; 12,139 of 15,666 (77.5%) against 21,642 of 27,469 (78.8%) for the 10x test; 20,202, 14,109 and 20,175 genes; 43,122 as the union of the three universes; 62 absent from all three as 7, 24 and 31; 456 of 622, 930 of 1,237, 91 of 117 genes and 1,419 of 2,348, 3,012 of 4,606, 247 of 379 transcripts from the legacy DML annotation tables; control-only 39,860 and run of 3,257; heat-only 43,118; md5 of the universe file; 4,096 x 1,289,932 = 5,283,561,472; input 1.2% smaller. The only number that did not survive is the genome-order count (listed above).

Not recomputed: the cut line; no request to gannet was made. It is confirmed by the verifier's saved bytes (out/junction_BOTH.bin: a line of XM_011455140.3 cut after 55 bytes, followed by a line of XM_034461020.1) and by the committed output of the new 06_diagnostics/universe_file_cut.R (file size 20,149,928,521 bytes, cut offset 5,283,561,472, checked 2026-11-19). The verifier's saved simulation output was re-analysed: one line cut, a fresh line at byte 561,152 = 4,096 x 137, 10,841 keys missing, tail written.

Where issues.md departs from the report and is right: 'under every collation tested' for the report's 'under any collation'. Where the report is imprecise: its caveat says 'the same transcripts' for the 3,967 stretches, and its list of execution counts ('30 to 33') is 29 to 33 in the notebook.

Smaller points, not listed as problems. (1) 'Of the transcripts of those genes' in Why it matters: the denominators 2,348, 4,606 and 379 are the transcripts with GO terms listed in the legacy DML annotation tables; the 622 and 1,237 genes have 2,366 and 4,660 mRNAs in all, and the rounded shares are the same either way. (2) '77.5% of the missing transcripts' is 12,139 of the 15,666 in the run; for all 15,715 missing it is 12,177, also 77.5%. (3) The same BOTH table is 'files of 19 to 33 GB' in I-35 (text of 2026-11-18, binary gigabytes) and '20 GB' in I-39. (4) I-35 treats the join tables on gannet as redundant intermediates whose cleanup is for the owner. The BOTH table is now the direct evidence for the cause in I-39 and the input of 06_diagnostics/universe_file_cut.R; I-35 should say that it must be kept until its bytes around the cut and its size are archived. (5) I-20 gives 625, 1,246 and 119 genes with GO terms and I-39 gives 622, 1,237 and 117 'by the legacy route'; by the verifier's script 05_dml_genes.R the difference comes from the NM_ names that step 08 repairs, the genes with hyphenated names, and the GO IDs absent from the GOslim table. (6) Apart from the proposed I-28 row, the changes proposed here alter text written after the verification, which the preamble of the corrections table does not cover.

discrepancies.proposed_text: A list confined to that run gives more terms below p = 0.01 than a random list of the same size, whatever the DML are. With every universe transcript of that accession run as the list of interest (11,284 of the 27,469 transcripts, no DML information), 1,041 of the 12,720 BP terms have p < 0.01, against a median of 52.5 for ten random lists of the same size (range 13 to 157), and nine of the ten legacy top BP terms for ploidy are among the 1,041. Limits: the check used one entry per transcript, not the line totals of the legacy test (I-43), and a list 18 times as long as the legacy list of 612 transcripts, so it does not separate the effect of position from the effect of list length. result.notes:
Overall: the editing carries the report's counts without a single wrong count in I-40, and the four I-40 rows of the corrections table describe real changes. The faults are in qualifiers: one limit dropped (high), one inference stated as fact together with a wrong year and a wrong 'not' (medium), one 'always' (medium), one range in I-43 (medium), one pipeline description still wrong after its correction (medium), and seven wording points (low).

Count: 18 items = 4 errors_found + 14 missing_caveats. Carried without fault: errors 1, 2, 3; caveats 1, 2, 7, 10, 12, 13 (9). Carried with a fault listed above: error 4; caveats 3, 4, 5, 9, 11, 14 (7). Omitted and needed: caveat 6. Deferred: caveat 8.

Origin of the faults. Introduced by the editing: the dropped limit of the position check; 'R 4.1, under which the legacy analysis ran'; the ambiguous 'alone'; 'used by step 09 only' (old text left beside the corrected sentence). Taken over from a report that is itself wrong or loose, judged against the data: 'written by the script in 2021' (C2-reader; the manifest and I-37 say 2022-03-07); 'always survives' (C2-reader states it and gives 44 of 47 in the same sentence); 'follow genome order' (C2-reader); '1.4 to 1.9 times' and 'every legacy p-value' (C3, computed for BP only). I found no place where issues.md departs from the report on purpose.

What I recomputed, all from files in the repository, each run under two minutes (scripts and small outputs in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-WGBS-gigas-ploidy-desiccation/ed665b6a-3457-5aca-a521-7838dbc31cfa/scratchpad/wf/check-C2-reader/: a_reader.R, b_margins.R, c_fig5.R, d_dedup_fig9.R, e_blastx.R, f_acc.R, g_block_null.R, h_block_size.R, i_knockout.R, j_complete_read.R, k_ties.R, l_dedup_ties.R, m_heat_tie.R, margins_recomputed.csv). Reproduced exactly: rows 10,979 of 46,626, 81,109 of 106,621, 6,941 of 7,029; transcripts 623 of 2,348, 3,444 of 4,606, 379 of 379; genes 171 of 622, 949 of 1,237, 117 of 117; in the universe 612, 2,148, 247 transcripts and 168, 610, 91 genes; universe as only filter 456, 930, 91 genes and 1,419, 3,012, 247 transcripts (I-39); 27, 88, 10 unpaired lines and 14, 44, 5 merged rows; both warnings for ploidy and none for heat and shared; knock-out and quote settings; 1,725 and 451, 1,162 and 288 lost; 603 of 623; 601 of 612 and 62.1%; isoform shares; control-only table 70,762 of 150,954 rows (53.1% lost); the gannet data/ copies equal the repository copies line for line; manifest dates 2021-11-24 and 2022-03-10; 1,254 against 498 under GO.db 3.18.0; R source files 4.1.0 against 4.3.3 (quote handling unchanged). Without topGO, by the hypergeometric formula on term membership, I reproduced all nine step 09 tables (p-values to 5e-14) and the complete-read results: 1 of 10, 7, 2 and 7, 7, 5 legacy top terms kept; terms with p < 0.01 708, 97, 167 and 1,152, 171, 247; Figure 9 totals 12, 38, 29 and 68, 73, 197; shared set unchanged. Ties at rank 10 under the complete read (ploidy BP, heat BP) are among terms with the same transcripts and do not affect these numbers.

One claim of the report that its scripts had not computed, and that issues.md carries, I tested and it holds: for the shared loci only the 'GO terms' counts of Figure 5 change under a complete read (3,332, 2,337, 1,262 against 3,396, 2,347, 1,276); 'Unique transcripts', 'Unique genes', 'Gene products' and Figure 9 are identical (c_fig5.R). I-43's 'one line per blastx alignment' also holds: map lines equal blastx rows for all 27,469 names.

Left out by the analyst and judged not needed, so not listed as omissions: the read with the apostrophe as only quote character (10,981 rows, 624 transcripts, 172 genes) and the two lines held by a double quote; the incomplete last row of the ploidy read; the shares 99.4%, 98.6% and 99.8%; gene-level position counts (6 of 323 against 161 of 274); stale comments at lines 945 and 947.

Smaller points not listed as discrepancies. 'R did warn for the ploidy table ... at each of its four reads' (line 668) is an observation under R 4.3.3 on the same call; the console output of the legacy run is not preserved, so 'R warns (R 4.3.3)' would be exact.
